acceptanceCriteria.text: One bounded integration seam creates AgentRuns only through Tsukai public API.
Provider/model/tool/guard/custom-tool intent maps to the M5.5 execution profile.
Existing Nawabari workspace/worktree binding is passed without widening authority.
Tsukai agentRunId is durably correlated with Manager/orchestration identity.
Repeating the same idempotent start does not create a second AgentRun.
Existing Pi runtime remains only as the pre-cutover path; no new duplicate lifecycle authority is added.

issue.title: impl: establish Tsukai AgentRun integration foundation
